# Deployment policy

Production deployments require a reviewed pull request, passing regression
tests, and an approved change record. The release owner must prepare a rollback
plan before deployment begins. If error rates exceed the service threshold, the
on-call engineer rolls back the deployment and opens an incident ticket.

Staging validation occurs before production approval. The quality team records
test evidence in the change record, and the release owner communicates the
deployment window to affected teams. This policy does not define employee
expense reimbursements or remote-work allowances.
